newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude climbs in late U.S. trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude climbs in late U.S. trading.

text.p: North Sea Brent crude oil climbed in late U.S. trading on Friday, traders said.
Two August Brent partials changed hands at $18.10 and $18.20 a barrel, with the cash price going out at $18.13-17.
Exchange-for-physical transactions were fetching a premium of two to four cents, traders said.
August Brent on London's IPE closed at $18.07 a barrel.
August/September Brent traded twice at minus seven cents a barrel, up two to three cents from trades earlier in the day.
September/October was assessed at minus 13-11 cents, while October/November was pegged at minus 15/12 cents.
